description: Register a custom domain for sending and receiving and return it (id, status pending) together with the DNS records to add: DKIM CNAMEs, MX and SPF for the mail-from subdomain, and DMARC. SentFromAI re-checks DNS automatically and marks the domain verified once the records propagate; poll with get_domain. Errors: 400 invalid hostname, 409 already registered.

hostname.description: Domain or subdomain you control, e.g. "mail.example.com".

name: add_domain
title: Add sending domain
